justification: Milestone 019 re-baseline. Every entry's raw closure is at or below the milestone 015 baseline; popover fell 0.7% and select 5.0%. gzipBytes is the sum of each module gzipped on its own, so it tracks how tsdown splits chunks as well as payload: popover now resolves to four chunks instead of three, which raised the summed figure 13.8% while the concatenated closure gzips to 4205 against a 4155 baseline. Re-recorded from the current build so the three entries that shrank are guarded at their new, smaller size.
